# 敖钦储量及产量规划协同项目产品需求文档（PRD）

版本：V0.3  
文件名沿用：`07-产品需求文档_PRD_V0.2.md`  
阶段：开发前 PRD  
阅读对象：产品经理、UI/UX、前端、后端、测试、项目经理

## 一、概述

### 1.1 背景

储量和产量规划是深圳公司增储上产、稳产上产和开发生产决策的重要基础。当前业务大量依赖 Excel、人工填报、线下检查、多轮版本传递和专家经验，存在数据分散、口径不统一、校验效率低、版本难对比、规律难沉淀、知识查询困难等问题。

本项目依托海能平台和敖钦智能体，建设“储量分析 + 产量规划 + 智能辅助”的协同工作台，目标是让储量和产量规划工作从“人手搬数据、Excel 反复试”转为“线上采集、规则校验、版本管理、图表分析、智能辅助”。

### 1.2 产品目标

| 目标 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 提升储量效率 | 由 130 余名员工近 6 个月人工统计，提效为线上自动分析一个月归档，目标效率提升 83.3% |
| 提升规划效率 | 单轮规划方案由周级缩短至日级，目标效率提升 85.7% |
| 提升质量 | 通过字段规则、公式管理、单元格错误定位、版本对比减少人工核对 |
| 支撑决策 | 对三条线储量、产量构成、开发状态、版本差异、规律趋势形成可视化和解释 |
| 沉淀知识 | 建设储量产量知识库，让制度、规范、模板和专家经验可问可查 |

### 1.3 目标用户

| 用户 | 用户想要什么 |
|---|---|
| 储量评价人员 | 少重复下载上传，快速发现储量数据问题，看三条线、3P3C、版本差异 |
| 综合规划人员 | 像 Excel 一样编方案，但能协同、校验、保存版本、导出成果 |
| 油区/油田负责人 | 按职责填报本油田数据，保存后上级可见，错误能定位 |
| 地质/油藏专业人员 | 看指标趋势、解释规律、辅助校验数据和模型合理性 |
| 勘探部/开发部管理人员 | 看进度、看风险、看版本差异、看汇报结果 |
| IT/系统管理员 | 管权限、接口、模板、公式、主数据、知识库和审计 |

### 1.4 当前待确认的基础口径

| 问题 | 状态 |
|---|---|
| 项目周期 Word 写 2026.05-2026.12，PPT/调研手册写 2026.03-2027.03 | `[待确认]` |
| 17 功能按 PPT 为 6+7+4，Word 为 6+8+3 | `[待确认]` |
| 三级权限“科室-油田统筹-油田负责人”是否为最终权限模型 | `[待确认]` |

## 二、产品范围

### 2.1 范围内

- 首页总览：任务进度、待办、异常、版本摘要、最近输出。
- 储量分析：数据采集清洗、三条线/3P3C 指标分析、难动用储量分级、版本对比、成果图表。
- 产量规划：历史生产分析、规划数据采集、方案编制、剖面调整、智能排期、版本对比、结果输出。
- 智能辅助：知识问答、智能问数、规律挖掘、规划算法工具调用。
- 系统管理：用户权限、主数据映射、模板、字段公式、数据源、知识库、审计。

### 2.2 范围外

- 不训练新的大模型。
- 不替换海能平台或敖钦智能体。
- 不在未确认公式时自动给出真实业务计算结论。
- 不在第一版 Demo 中接真实后端、数据库、OA、数据湖、敖钦/海能。
- 不把 Mock 数据或 Mock AI 回答伪装成真实结果。

## 三、核心流程

### 3.1 储量分析流程

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A["接入储量数据"] --> B["字段/单位/精度/范围校验"]
    B --> C["清洗与标准化"]
    C --> D["内部储量/动储量入库"]
    D --> E["三条线与 3P3C 分析"]
    E --> F["难动用储量分级"]
    F --> G["历史版本对比"]
    G --> H["成果图表与导出"]
```

### 3.2 产量规划流程

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A["发起规划任务"] --> B["历史数据分析"]
    B --> C["油区/油田填报"]
    C --> D["类 Excel 校验与公式"]
    D --> E["方案编制"]
    E --> F["剖面调整与排期"]
    F --> G["保存新版本"]
    G --> H["版本对比"]
    H --> I["结果输出"]
```

### 3.3 智能辅助流程

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as 用户
    participant S as 业务系统
    participant A as 敖钦/海能
    participant D as 数据服务
    participant T as 工具服务

    U->>S: 提问/问数/调用工具
    S->>A: 发送上下文与意图
    alt 知识问答
        A-->>S: 答案与引用
    else 智能问数
        A-->>S: 查询意图
        S->>D: 权限过滤后查询
        D-->>S: 数据结果
    else 工具调用
        S->>T: 参数校验与计算
        T-->>S: 工具结果
    end
    S-->>U: 展示结果、来源、参数、版本、日志
```

## 四、页面需求

### 4.1 首页总览

| 项 | 需求 |
|---|---|
| 目标 | 让用户知道当前储量和产量规划工作进度、异常和下一步 |
| 内容 | 指标卡、待办、异常、油区填报进度、版本摘要、最近输出、AI 入口 |
| 主操作 | 继续待办、进入异常、查看版本、进入模块 |
| 状态 | 加载、无待办、加载失败、权限不足 |
| 待确认 | 首页指标口径、待办来源、领导视图 |

### 4.2 储量分析

| 页面 | 功能需求 | 关键交互 |
|---|---|---|
| 数据采集与清洗 | 接入内部储量、动储量、历史数据，按模板规则校验 | 上传/拉取、校验、错误定位、清洗日志 |
| 指标分析 | 三条线、内部储量、3P3C、商业性条件、油气田状态分析 | 维度选择、图表切换、表图联动、AI 解释 |
| 难动用储量分级 | 按分类标准输出分级结果 | 分级查看、人工复核、原因说明 |
| 版本对比 | 多版本储量指标、计算单元、口径变化对比 | 选择版本、只看差异、导出差异 |
| 成果输出 | 输出标准图表、统计图件和归档记录 | 图表生成、模板导出、版本归档 |

### 4.3 产量规划

| 页面 | 功能需求 | 关键交互 |
|---|---|---|
| 历史生产分析 | 清洗历史产量，生成基础指标和曲线 | 筛选油田/井、查看趋势、异常标记 |
| 规划数据采集 | 多角色在线填报规划基础数据 | 可填/不可填、备注提示、保存、上级可见 |
| 方案编制 | 年度/五年/滚动/专项规划任务编制 | 类 Excel 主表、字段公式、校验、保存版本 |
| 剖面调整与智能排期 | 产量曲线、投产时间、工作量、约束调整 | 调整参数、查看前后变化、无解提示 |
| 版本对比 | 多轮规划方案差异对比 | 选版本、看差异、生成摘要、导出 |
| 结果输出 | 总表、常用图表、汇报材料输出 | 模板导出、记录版本、查看日志 |

### 4.4 智能辅助

| 能力 | 需求 |
|---|---|
| 知识问答 | 问规范、制度、模板和口径，答案带引用 |
| 智能问数 | 用自然语言查询储量/产量/规划数据，显示查询说明 |
| 规律挖掘 | 对递减率、采收率、动用率等指标生成趋势解释 |
| 工具调用 | 触发规划曲线、指标计算等工具，展示参数和日志 |
| 跨页面助手 | 在储量/产量页面解释当前图表、表格、版本差异 |

### 4.5 系统管理

| 页面 | 需求 |
|---|---|
| 用户与权限 | 管用户、角色、组织、数据范围、知识库权限 |
| 主数据映射 | 管油气区、油田、气田、井、别名、状态、唯一标识 |
| 模板与公式 | 管 Excel 模板、导出模板、字段公式、单元格规则 |
| 知识库管理 | 管文档上传、分类、版本、权限、失效 |
| 数据源与审计 | 管接口状态、同步日志、操作日志、AI 调用日志 |

## 五、关键业务规则

| 规则 | 说明 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|
| 三条线储量 | 国家线、内部线、上市线都要能分析和对比 | 口径 `[待确认]` |
| 3P3C | 储量模板包含 P1/P2/P3/C1/C2/C3 与商业性条件 | 细则 `[待确认]` |
| 产量状态 | 在生产、在建设、开发评价、勘探评价、待发现 | 来自技术规范 |
| 年度产量构成 | 基础产量、措施产量、调整井产量、开发井产量 | 来自 QHS 2062 |
| 字段公式 | 用字段名公式，不用 Excel 坐标公式 | 公式清单 `[待确认]` |
| 主数据 | 油田状态和井名唯一标识影响规划表计算 | 主键配置 `[待确认]` |
| 权限 | 会议记录暂定三级，Excel 框架提到一级/二级权限 | 最终矩阵 `[待确认]` |

## 六、非功能需求

| 类型 | 需求 |
|---|---|
| 安全 | 等保 2.0 二级，内网访问，统一认证，权限控制，审计日志 |
| 可用性 | 每个页面有加载、空态、错误态、权限态 |
| 可追溯 | 数据、规则、公式、版本、导出、AI 调用均可追溯 |
| 性能 | AI 查询响应、NL2SQL 准确率、版本差异检出等指标需确认 |
| 兼容 | Web/OA 系统形式兼容，桌面端优先 |
| 运维 | 监控巡检、知识库更新、备份、故障响应、日志分析 |

## 七、验收标准

| 模块 | 验收标准 |
|---|---|
| 储量分析 | 能用样例储量模板跑通采集、校验、指标分析、版本对比、成果输出 |
| 产量规划 | 能用样例规划模板跑通填报、公式提示、方案编制、剖面调整、版本对比、结果输出 |
| 智能辅助 | 能完成知识问答、问数、规律解释、工具调用，并展示引用/参数/日志 |
| 系统管理 | 能展示用户权限、主数据、模板公式、知识库、审计入口 |
| Demo | 所有 Mock 数据标识清楚，不能误导为真实敖钦/海能或真实生产数据 |

## 八、第一版 Demo 要求

第一版 Demo 用 Vue 工作台实现：

- 登录页支持多角色一键演示。
- 首页、储量采集、储量指标、储量版本、规划方案、剖面调整、规划版本、智能辅助做完整交互。
- 系统管理和错误页做基础页面。
- Mock 数据集中在 `src/mock/`。
- 所有复杂计算、AI 结果、权限差异均标注演示或 `[待确认]`。

# 敖钦储量及产量规划协同项目整体产品架构

版本：V0.3  
定位：页面开发前的产品架构基线  
需求源头：`原始需求/` Word、0317 PPT、会议记录、储量/产量 Excel、产量技术规范 PDF

## 1. 产品定位

本系统是面向深圳公司储量评估、储量动用分析、产量规划编制和开发生产规律研究的企业级协同工作台。它不是单纯报表系统，也不是纯聊天工具，而是把“数据采集、数据治理、业务分析、类 Excel 规划、版本对比、成果输出、敖钦/海能智能辅助”组成一个闭环。

核心形态：

```text
数据底座 + 智能中枢 + 业务应用
```

## 3. 业务域划分

| 业务域 | 用户想要什么 | 产品要做成什么样 | 关键对象 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 储量分析 | 少搬 Excel，少重复核对，能看三条线和版本差异 | 数据采集清洗 + 标准化储量库 + 指标分析 + 版本对比 + 图表成果 | 三条线储量、内部储量、动储量、3P3C、商业性条件、计算单元、版本 |
| 产量规划 | 像 Excel 一样高效填，但比 Excel 更安全、可追溯、能协同 | 类 Excel 规划工作台 + 任务流程 + 公式管理 + 剖面调整 + 版本输出 | 油田/气田/井、年度/五年/滚动/专项规划、产量构成、开发状态、版本 |
| 智能辅助 | 能问制度、问数据、问规律，也能触发工具但不乱改数据 | 独立智能中心 + 跨页面右侧助手 + 来源引用 + 工具调用日志 | 知识文档、自然语言问题、SQL/查询说明、工具参数、AI 记录 |
| 系统管理 | 权限、模板、数据源、公式、主数据都可管理可审计 | 配置中心 + 操作日志 + 接口状态 + 知识库维护 | 用户角色、组织、模板、字段、公式、数据源、审计日志 |

| 综合规划人员 | 发起规划任务、收集数据、编制方案、调剖面、出成果 | 首页、规划采集、方案编制、剖面调整、版本对比 | 年度/五年/滚动/专项规划关系 `[待确认]` |

## 6. 储量主流程

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A["接入储量填报系统/数据湖/历史 Excel"] --> B["字段、单位、精度、范围校验"]
    B --> C["形成内部储量与动储量标准数据"]
    C --> D["三条线储量与 3P3C 分析"]
    D --> E["难动用储量分级与人工复核"]
    E --> F["历史版本对比"]
    F --> G["成果图表与导出归档"]
```

储量侧必须保留：

- 三条线储量：国家线、内部线、上市线。
- 内部储量以可采储量为主线，包含各级地质储量及 SPE 体系下剩余可采储量 3P3C。
- 模板中的计算单元、层位、沉积相、岩性、油藏类型、单位、精度、异常范围等校验提示。
- 商业性、次商业性、动用、未动用、P1/P2/P3/C1/C2/C3 等分类。

## 7. 产量规划主流程

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A["发起规划任务"] --> B["接入历史产量与基础资料"]
    B --> C["多角色填报规划数据"]
    C --> D["类 Excel 公式与校验"]
    D --> E["方案编制与版本保存"]
    E --> F["产量剖面调整"]
    F --> G["智能排期/工具计算"]
    G --> H["多版本对比"]
    H --> I["结果输出与归档"]
```

产量侧必须保留：

- 规划类型：年度产量预测、五年规划、滚动规划、专项规划。
- 开发状态：在生产、在建设、开发评价、勘探评价、待发现。
- 年度产量构成：基础产量、措施产量、调整井产量、开发井产量。
- 常见预测方法：递减法、水驱曲线法、油藏数值模拟法、类比法。
- 类 Excel 协同：冻结表头、单元格备注、可填/不可填、按时间锁定剖面、公式统一管理。

## 8. 数据流与系统集成

| 数据 | 来源 | 处理 | 使用位置 | 待确认 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 储量历史数据 | 储量填报系统、数据湖、历史模板 | 接口推送或批量导入、清洗、标准化、版本管理 | 储量采集、指标分析、版本对比 | 储量系统 API 是否稳定 `[待确认]` |
| 内部储量/动储量模板 | 储量 Excel 模板 | 字段、单位、精度、范围、编码表解析 | 在线填报、校验、成果图表 | 真实模板是否最终版 `[待确认]` |
| 历史产量数据 | 开发生产工作平台、数据湖、批量导入 | 单位统一、异常修正、月/年粒度处理 | 历史生产分析、剖面调整 | 时间跨度、字段字典 `[待确认]` |
| 规划采集数据 | 油区/油田/专业室在线填报 | 主数据映射、权限校验、公式计算、版本保存 | 规划采集、方案编制 | 并发编辑和锁定机制 `[待确认]` |
| 知识文档 | 制度、规范、模板、专家经验 | 人工清洗后上传海能，建立知识库索引 | 知识问答、AI 解释 | 文档范围和维护人 `[待确认]` |
| AI 调用记录 | 敖钦/海能、业务系统工具 | 参数、结果、引用、耗时、错误留痕 | 智能辅助、审计 | 日志保存周期 `[待确认]` |

## 9. AI 边界

| 能力 | 敖钦/海能负责 | 业务系统必须控制 | 页面呈现 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 知识问答 | 检索、理解、组织回答 | 知识来源、权限、引用、纠错流程 | 答案 + 引用 + 置信提示 |
| 智能问数 | 自然语言理解、SQL/查询意图生成 `[待确认]` | 数据模型、权限过滤、查询执行、结果校验 | 查询说明 + 表格/图表 + 权限提示 |
| 规律挖掘 | 解释趋势、生成摘要、支持追问 | 指标公式、算法结果、专家复核 | 摘要 + 指标 + “需复核”标识 |
| 工具调用 | 意图识别、参数抽取、调用编排 `[待确认]` | 算法服务、参数边界、超时、缓存、异步任务 | 参数日志 + 计算状态 + 结果图 |

AI 不得自动覆盖储量数据、规划方案或版本结果；所有 AI 输出都必须能看到来源、参数、版本或调用记录。

## 10. 架构原则

1. 一页一任务，不把采集、分析、审批、AI 问答堆在一屏。
2. 储量和产量规划都按“数据 + 公式/口径 + 版本 + 解释 + 输出”设计。
3. 类 Excel 是产量规划主体验，普通表格不能替代业务人员的填报习惯。
4. AI 是辅助，不替代未确认的业务公式、审批链路和专家判断。
5. 所有冲突、待确认和大幅改动，必须先用非技术语言问用户。

# 敖钦储量及产量规划协同项目 UI 设计规范

版本：V0.3  
UI 方向：企业级业务工作台 + 类 Excel 协同 + 适度智能助手

## 1. 设计定位

本系统服务研究院、勘探部、开发部、储量评价、综合规划、地质油藏等高频业务人员。界面必须像一个能长期使用的业务工作台，而不是营销页、大屏页或纯 AI 聊天页。

第一优先级是让用户高效完成：

- 看进度。
- 填数据。
- 查错误。
- 看图表。
- 对版本。
- 出成果。
- 问知识和问数据。

## 2. 设计原则

| 原则 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 一页一任务 | 首页看状态，采集页填数和查错，分析页看指标，版本页对差异 |
| 表格优先 | 储量和产量规划都是高密度数据业务，表格体验必须优先于装饰性卡片 |
| 类 Excel 但更安全 | 保留冻结列、横向滚动、单元格备注、公式感知，同时增加权限、版本、审计 |
| 规则可见 | 用户填基础数据时能看到填写要求，错误能定位到行、列、单元格 |
| 口径可追溯 | 图表、指标、AI 解释都要显示来源、版本、单位、口径或引用 |
| AI 不抢主线 | AI 在右侧抽屉或独立中心辅助，不自动修改业务数据 |

## 3. 视觉基调

| 项 | 规范 |
|---|---|
| 整体气质 | 安静、清晰、专业、适合高频办公 |
| 主色 | 稳重蓝或海洋蓝，具体以甲方门户规范为准 `[待确认]` |
| 辅助色 | 成功绿、预警橙、错误红、中性灰，避免单一蓝色铺满 |
| 背景 | 浅灰工作台背景 + 白色内容面，不使用大面积渐变和装饰图形 |
| 圆角 | 6-8px 为主 |
| 字体 | 系统无衬线字体，表格数字清晰 |
| 阴影 | 少用重阴影，通过边框和背景层级区分 |
| 图标 | 使用统一图标库，按钮内优先 icon + 短文本 |

## 4. 全局布局

| 区域 | 规则 |
|---|---|
| 顶部栏 | 56-64px，系统名、当前任务、Mock 提示、搜索、AI 入口、用户信息 |
| 侧边栏 | 一级导航固定，储量/产量子页面在模块内展开 |
| 主内容 | 留给表格、图表、流程、版本对比，不放大段说明 |
| 右侧抽屉 | AI 助手、单元格规则、版本说明、操作日志、错误详情 |
| 底部条 | 批量操作、保存状态、分页、导出状态 |

## 5. 首页设计

首页不是大屏驾驶舱，而是“任务进度首页”。

必须包含：

- 储量采集完成率。
- 产量规划填报进度。
- 异常数据/异常单元格数量。
- 待确认版本。
- 待办和最近输出。
- 各油区/油田填报进度。

禁止：

- 大段宣传文案。
- 只有图表没有可点击任务。
- 只展示领导指标，不给业务人员进入工作流。

## 6. 类 Excel 表格规范

| 场景 | 设计要求 |
|---|---|
| 储量录入表 | 字段多、单位多、精度要求明确，必须支持字段说明、错误定位、批量校验 |
| 规划主表 | 冻结油气田、别名、油气区、状态等关键列；年份横向滚动 |
| 公式结果 | 用“字段公式”展示，例如 `[基础产量] + [措施增量]`，不展示 `A2+B2` 作为业务规则 |
| 可填/不可填 | 不可填单元格置灰并提示原因 |
| 备注提示 | 鼠标悬浮显示填写要求、单位、范围、示例 |
| 错误定位 | 类 IDE 报错体验：标红、错误列表、点击错误跳到单元格 |
| 锁定范围 | 根据输入时间或任务状态锁定剖面填写范围 `[待确认]` |
| 协同 | 展示在线人员和保存状态；真实多人编辑机制 `[待确认]` |

表格必须有加载骨架、空态、错误态、权限不足态、保存成功反馈。

## 7. 图表规范

| 图表 | 用途 | 规则 |
|---|---|---|
| 趋势折线 | 储量、产量、递减曲线 | 标注单位、版本、时间范围 |
| 对比柱状 | 三条线、版本差异、油气区对比 | 支持只看差异/只看异常 |
| 构成图 | 分油气田状态、分油气区、产量构成 | 可联动明细表 |
| 曲线图 | 剖面调整、预测曲线、采收率曲线 | 显示调整前后和参数来源 |
| 指标卡 | 首页和模块总览 | 只放关键指标，能点击进入明细 |

用户可自定义统计维度和图表类型，但第一版 Demo 只做基础筛选和图表切换，真实自由组合规则 `[待确认]`。

## 8. AI 助手规范

| 场景 | 展示方式 | 要求 |
|---|---|---|
| 跨页面解释 | 右侧抽屉 | 读取当前页面上下文，但不自动修改数据 |
| 知识问答 | 智能辅助中心 | 展示引用来源、知识库命中、更新时间 |
| 智能问数 | 问题 + 查询说明 + 表格/图表 | 显示权限过滤和查询口径 |
| 工具调用 | 参数面板 + 调用日志 + 结果图 | 显示参数、耗时、失败原因 |
| 规律挖掘 | 摘要 + 图表 + 明细 | 标注“需专家复核” |

AI 输出禁止：

- 无引用来源直接给确定性结论。
- 把本地 Mock 回答伪装成真实敖钦成功。
- 自动覆盖业务数据或规划方案。
- 隐藏查询语义、参数、版本。

## 9. 状态设计

def emu(value: float):
    return Inches(value)


def blank(prs: Presentation):
    return base.blank(prs)


def rect(slide, x, y, w, h, fill=WHITE, line=BORDER, radius=False, width=0.7):
    return base.add_rect(slide, emu(x), emu(y), emu(w), emu(h), fill, line, radius, width)


def line(slide, x1, y1, x2, y2, color=BLUE, width=1.5):
    return base.add_line(slide, emu(x1), emu(y1), emu(x2), emu(y2), color, width)


def txt(slide, x, y, w, h, text, size=12, color=TEXT, bold=False, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, valign=MSO_ANCHOR.TOP):
    box = base.add_text(slide, emu(x), emu(y), emu(w), emu(h), text, size, color, bold, align, valign)
    for p in box.text_frame.paragraphs:
        for run in p.runs:
            run.font.name = FONT
            run.font.size = Pt(size)
    return box


def title(slide, heading, sub="", page=None):
    base.header(slide, heading, sub, page)


def section(prs, num, heading, caption, bg):
    base.FONT = FONT
    return base.section_slide(prs, num, heading, caption, bg)


def add_bg(slide, color=WHITE):
    base.fill_bg(slide, color)


def img(slide, path, x, y, w, h, border=True):
    return base.add_image_contain(slide, Path(path), emu(x), emu(y), emu(w), emu(h), border)


def card(slide, x, y, w, h, head, body, color=BLUE, idx=None, body_size=10.5):
    rect(slide, x, y, w, h, WHITE, BORDER, True, 0.8)
    rect(slide, x, y, w, 0.36, color, color, True, 0)
    if idx:
        txt(slide, x + 0.13, y + 0.105, 0.34, 0.12, idx, 8.5, WHITE, True, PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
        tx = x + 0.54
    else:
        tx = x + 0.18
    txt(slide, tx, y + 0.095, w - (tx - x) - 0.14, 0.14, head, 10.5, WHITE, True)
    txt(slide, x + 0.18, y + 0.52, w - 0.34, h - 0.58, body, body_size, TEXT)


def kpi(slide, x, y, value, label, color=BLUE, w=1.95):
    rect(slide, x, y, w, 0.72, WHITE, BORDER, True, 0.7)
    rect(slide, x, y, 0.08, 0.72, color, color, False, 0)
    txt(slide, x + 0.18, y + 0.10, w - 0.26, 0.25, value, 18, color, True, PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    txt(slide, x + 0.14, y + 0.45, w - 0.22, 0.13, label, 9.2, MUTED, False, PP_ALIGN.CENTER)


def table(slide, x, y, w, h, headers, rows, widths=None, font=9.2, header_color=BLUE, highlight=True):
    widths = widths or [1] * len(headers)
    total = sum(widths)
    widths = [w * each / total for each in widths]
    row_h = h / (len(rows) + 1)
    cx = x
    for i, head in enumerate(headers):
        rect(slide, cx, y, widths[i], row_h, header_color, header_color, False, 0)
        txt(slide, cx + 0.05, y + row_h * 0.30, widths[i] - 0.10, row_h * 0.25, str(head), font + 0.8, WHITE, True, PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
        cx += widths[i]
    for r, row in enumerate(rows):
        cy = y + row_h * (r + 1)
        cx = x
        fill = RGBColor(248, 251, 255) if r % 2 == 0 else WHITE
        for c, cell in enumerate(row):
            text = str(cell)
            color = TEXT
            cfill = fill
            if highlight and ("待确认" in text or "风险" in text or "冲突" in text):
                color = RED
                cfill = LIGHT_RED
            rect(slide, cx, cy, widths[c], row_h, cfill, BORDER, False, 0.45)
            txt(slide, cx + 0.07, cy + row_h * 0.22, widths[c] - 0.13, row_h * 0.44, text, font, color, False)
            cx += widths[c]


def flow(slide, items, x, y, w, h, colors=None, size=9.2):
    colors = colors or [BLUE, TEAL, GREEN, ORANGE, RED, BLUE2]
    gap = 0.18
    bw = (w - gap * (len(items) - 1)) / len(items)
    for i, (head, body) in enumerate(items):
        bx = x + i * (bw + gap)
        rect(slide, bx, y, bw, h, WHITE, colors[i % len(colors)], True, 1.2)
        rect(slide, bx, y, bw, 0.34, colors[i % len(colors)], colors[i % len(colors)], True, 0)
        txt(slide, bx, y + 0.10, bw, 0.12, f"{i+1}  {head}", 9.5, WHITE, True, PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
        txt(slide, bx + 0.10, y + 0.49, bw - 0.20, h - 0.56, body, size, TEXT, False, PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
        if i < len(items) - 1:
            line(slide, bx + bw, y + h / 2, bx + bw + gap, y + h / 2, colors[i % len(colors)], 1.8)

def validate(write_report=True) -> dict:
    ns = {"a": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"}
    fonts: dict[str, int] = {}
    sizes: list[float] = []
    body_sizes: list[float] = []
    ppt_texts: list[str] = []
    with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT_PPTX, "r") as zf:
        slide_names = [n for n in zf.namelist() if re.match(r"ppt/slides/slide\d+\.xml$", n)]
        media = [n for n in zf.namelist() if n.startswith("ppt/media/")]
        for name in slide_names:
            tree = ET.fromstring(zf.read(name))
            for r in tree.findall(".//a:r", ns):
                text = "".join((t.text or "") for t in r.findall("./a:t", ns)).strip()
                if not text:
                    continue
                ppt_texts.append(text)
                rpr = r.find("./a:rPr", ns)
                if rpr is None:
                    continue
                if rpr.attrib.get("sz"):
                    size = int(rpr.attrib["sz"]) / 100
                    sizes.append(size)
                    if len(text) >= 4 and not text.isdigit():
                        body_sizes.append(size)
                latin = rpr.find("./a:latin", ns)
                ea = rpr.find("./a:ea", ns)
                font = None
                if ea is not None and ea.attrib.get("typeface"):
                    font = ea.attrib["typeface"]
                elif latin is not None and latin.attrib.get("typeface"):
                    font = latin.attrib["typeface"]
                if font:
                    fonts[font] = fonts.get(font, 0) + 1
    text = OUT_OUTLINE.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if OUT_OUTLINE.exists() else ""
    text += OUT_CHECK.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if OUT_CHECK.exists() else ""
    text += "\n".join(ppt_texts)
    text += OUT_PPTX.name
    required = ["6+7+4", "17 项", "160 万", "54 个油田", "9 个气田", "720 口井", "20万+"]
    bad_fonts = [f for f in fonts if f in {"宋体", "仿宋", "Times New Roman"}]
    result = {
        "slides": len(slide_names),
        "media": len(media),
        "top_fonts": sorted(fonts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:6],
        "min_size": min(sizes) if sizes else None,
        "min_body_size": min(body_sizes) if body_sizes else None,
        "missing": [item for item in required if item not in text],
        "bad_fonts": bad_fonts,
        "pptx": str(OUT_PPTX),
    }
    if write_report:
        OUT_CHECK.write_text(check_report(result), encoding="utf-8")
    return result


def build_contact_sheet() -> Path | None:
    images = sorted(
        [p for p in PREVIEW_DIR.glob("幻灯片*.*") if p.suffix.lower() == ".png"],
        key=lambda p: int(re.search(r"(\d+)", p.stem).group(1)),
    )
    if not images:
        images = sorted([p for p in PREVIEW_DIR.glob("Slide*.*") if p.suffix.lower() == ".png"], key=lambda p: p.name)
    if not images:
        return None
    thumbs = []
    for path in images:
        im = Image.open(path).convert("RGB")
        im.thumbnail((320, 180))
        canvas = Image.new("RGB", (340, 220), (236, 242, 250))
        canvas.paste(im, ((340 - im.width) // 2, 8))
        label = path.stem.encode("gbk", errors="ignore").decode("gbk", errors="ignore")
        # PIL's default font may not render Chinese reliably; file order is enough.
        thumbs.append(canvas)
    cols = 4
    rows = math.ceil(len(thumbs) / cols)
    sheet = Image.new("RGB", (cols * 340, rows * 220), (226, 235, 247))
    for i, thumb in enumerate(thumbs):
        sheet.paste(thumb, ((i % cols) * 340, (i // cols) * 220))
    out = PREVIEW_DIR / "contact_sheet.jpg"
    sheet.save(out, quality=90)
    return out

Last updated: 2026-06-26

## 项目定位

本项目是中海油深圳分公司南海东部石油研究院的“储量分析 + 产量规划 + 敖钦智能辅助”协同业务系统。当前处于页面开发前的产品、架构、UI、技术路线和规则准备阶段。

## 当前文档位置

统一文档目录：`项目开发文档/`

主线文档：

- `00-开发前准备总览.md`
- `01-整体产品架构.md`
- `02-页面清单与线框设计.md`
- `03-UI设计规范.md`
- `04-技术路线评估.md`

- `06-功能清单_开发版.md`
- `07-产品需求文档_PRD_V0.2.md`
- `08-待确认事项清单.md`

第一版需求归档：`项目开发文档/90-第一版需求归档/`

## 已确认方向

- 文档包优先，不创建前端/后端代码骨架。
- UI 方向：企业级业务工作台 + 适度智能助手。
- 技术路线需要重新评估，但保留甲方约束：敖钦/海能、海油云、等保 2.0 二级、国产化数据库。
- 推荐技术路线：Vue3 + TypeScript + Vite + Vue Router + Pinia；Ant Design Vue + VXE Table + ECharts；Java/Spring Boot；人大金仓 + TDengine + Redis + MongoDB。
- 项目根 `AGENTS.md` 是后续 Agent 工作硬规则。

## 用户强约束

1. 任何不确定内容都必须问用户。
2. 涉及大幅度改动、已有内容冲突、页面结构变化、技术路线变化、功能删除或新增时，必须先问用户。
3. 提问必须用通俗易懂的非技术性语言说明影响和选项。
4. 以后做项目要多问、多确认，不要替用户做隐含决策。
5. 不得自动打开浏览器窗口。

## 关键待确认

所有待确认事项集中在 `项目开发文档/08-待确认事项清单.md`。开发前必须优先确认业务流程、真实样例文件、数据接口、敖钦/海能能力、页面验收卡和工程技术栈。

## 本地经验沉淀

过往项目返工的主要原因包括：

- 没有先锁定本轮改哪一层问题。
- 页面 IA 没确认就直接改 UI。
- 一页承载太多任务，导致用户不知道先做什么。
- UI 改动没有设计系统和验收卡。
- 技术实现替用户做了产品决定。

本项目后续必须先确认页面职责、主流程、验收卡，再进入实现。

# 敖钦储量及产量规划协同项目产品需求文档（PRD）

版本：V0.3  
文件名沿用：`07-产品需求文档_PRD_V0.2.md`  
阶段：开发前 PRD  
阅读对象：产品经理、UI/UX、前端、后端、测试、项目经理

## 一、概述

### 1.1 背景

储量和产量规划是深圳公司增储上产、稳产上产和开发生产决策的重要基础。当前业务大量依赖 Excel、人工填报、线下检查、多轮版本传递和专家经验，存在数据分散、口径不统一、校验效率低、版本难对比、规律难沉淀、知识查询困难等问题。

本项目依托海能平台和敖钦智能体，建设“储量分析 + 产量规划 + 智能辅助”的协同工作台，目标是让储量和产量规划工作从“人手搬数据、Excel 反复试”转为“线上采集、规则校验、版本管理、图表分析、智能辅助”。

### 1.2 产品目标

| 目标 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 提升储量效率 | 由 130 余名员工近 6 个月人工统计，提效为线上自动分析一个月归档，目标效率提升 83.3% |
| 提升规划效率 | 单轮规划方案由周级缩短至日级，目标效率提升 85.7% |
| 提升质量 | 通过字段规则、公式管理、单元格错误定位、版本对比减少人工核对 |
| 支撑决策 | 对三条线储量、产量构成、开发状态、版本差异、规律趋势形成可视化和解释 |
| 沉淀知识 | 建设储量产量知识库，让制度、规范、模板和专家经验可问可查 |

### 1.3 目标用户

| 用户 | 用户想要什么 |
|---|---|
| 储量评价人员 | 少重复下载上传，快速发现储量数据问题，看三条线、3P3C、版本差异 |
| 综合规划人员 | 像 Excel 一样编方案，但能协同、校验、保存版本、导出成果 |
| 油区/油田负责人 | 按职责填报本油田数据，保存后上级可见，错误能定位 |
| 地质/油藏专业人员 | 看指标趋势、解释规律、辅助校验数据和模型合理性 |
| 勘探部/开发部管理人员 | 看进度、看风险、看版本差异、看汇报结果 |
| IT/系统管理员 | 管权限、接口、模板、公式、主数据、知识库和审计 |

### 1.4 当前待确认的基础口径

| 问题 | 状态 |
|---|---|
| 项目周期 Word 写 2026.05-2026.12，PPT/调研手册写 2026.03-2027.03 | `[待确认]` |
| 17 功能按 PPT 为 6+7+4，Word 为 6+8+3 | `[待确认]` |
| 三级权限“科室-油田统筹-油田负责人”是否为最终权限模型 | `[待确认]` |

## 二、产品范围

### 2.1 范围内

- 首页总览：任务进度、待办、异常、版本摘要、最近输出。
- 储量分析：数据采集清洗、三条线/3P3C 指标分析、难动用储量分级、版本对比、成果图表。
- 产量规划：历史生产分析、规划数据采集、方案编制、剖面调整、智能排期、版本对比、结果输出。
- 智能辅助：知识问答、智能问数、规律挖掘、规划算法工具调用。
- 系统管理：用户权限、主数据映射、模板、字段公式、数据源、知识库、审计。

### 2.2 范围外

- 不训练新的大模型。
- 不替换海能平台或敖钦智能体。
- 不在未确认公式时自动给出真实业务计算结论。
- 不在第一版 Demo 中接真实后端、数据库、OA、数据湖、敖钦/海能。
- 不把 Mock 数据或 Mock AI 回答伪装成真实结果。

## 三、核心流程

### 3.1 储量分析流程

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A["接入储量数据"] --> B["字段/单位/精度/范围校验"]
    B --> C["清洗与标准化"]
    C --> D["内部储量/动储量入库"]
    D --> E["三条线与 3P3C 分析"]
    E --> F["难动用储量分级"]
    F --> G["历史版本对比"]
    G --> H["成果图表与导出"]
```

### 3.2 产量规划流程

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    A["发起规划任务"] --> B["历史数据分析"]
    B --> C["油区/油田填报"]
    C --> D["类 Excel 校验与公式"]
    D --> E["方案编制"]
    E --> F["剖面调整与排期"]
    F --> G["保存新版本"]
    G --> H["版本对比"]
    H --> I["结果输出"]
```

### 3.3 智能辅助流程

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as 用户
    participant S as 业务系统
    participant A as 敖钦/海能
    participant D as 数据服务
    participant T as 工具服务

    U->>S: 提问/问数/调用工具
    S->>A: 发送上下文与意图
    alt 知识问答
        A-->>S: 答案与引用
    else 智能问数
        A-->>S: 查询意图
        S->>D: 权限过滤后查询
        D-->>S: 数据结果
    else 工具调用
        S->>T: 参数校验与计算
        T-->>S: 工具结果
    end
    S-->>U: 展示结果、来源、参数、版本、日志
```

## 四、页面需求

### 4.1 首页总览

| 项 | 需求 |
|---|---|
| 目标 | 让用户知道当前储量和产量规划工作进度、异常和下一步 |
| 内容 | 指标卡、待办、异常、油区填报进度、版本摘要、最近输出、AI 入口 |
| 主操作 | 继续待办、进入异常、查看版本、进入模块 |
| 状态 | 加载、无待办、加载失败、权限不足 |
| 待确认 | 首页指标口径、待办来源、领导视图 |

### 4.2 储量分析

| 页面 | 功能需求 | 关键交互 |
|---|---|---|
| 数据采集与清洗 | 接入内部储量、动储量、历史数据，按模板规则校验 | 上传/拉取、校验、错误定位、清洗日志 |
| 指标分析 | 三条线、内部储量、3P3C、商业性条件、油气田状态分析 | 维度选择、图表切换、表图联动、AI 解释 |
| 难动用储量分级 | 按分类标准输出分级结果 | 分级查看、人工复核、原因说明 |
| 版本对比 | 多版本储量指标、计算单元、口径变化对比 | 选择版本、只看差异、导出差异 |
| 成果输出 | 输出标准图表、统计图件和归档记录 | 图表生成、模板导出、版本归档 |

### 4.3 产量规划

| 页面 | 功能需求 | 关键交互 |
|---|---|---|
| 历史生产分析 | 清洗历史产量，生成基础指标和曲线 | 筛选油田/井、查看趋势、异常标记 |
| 规划数据采集 | 多角色在线填报规划基础数据 | 可填/不可填、备注提示、保存、上级可见 |
| 方案编制 | 年度/五年/滚动/专项规划任务编制 | 类 Excel 主表、字段公式、校验、保存版本 |
| 剖面调整与智能排期 | 产量曲线、投产时间、工作量、约束调整 | 调整参数、查看前后变化、无解提示 |
| 版本对比 | 多轮规划方案差异对比 | 选版本、看差异、生成摘要、导出 |
| 结果输出 | 总表、常用图表、汇报材料输出 | 模板导出、记录版本、查看日志 |

### 4.4 智能辅助

| 能力 | 需求 |
|---|---|
| 知识问答 | 问规范、制度、模板和口径，答案带引用 |
| 智能问数 | 用自然语言查询储量/产量/规划数据，显示查询说明 |
| 规律挖掘 | 对递减率、采收率、动用率等指标生成趋势解释 |
| 工具调用 | 触发规划曲线、指标计算等工具，展示参数和日志 |
| 跨页面助手 | 在储量/产量页面解释当前图表、表格、版本差异 |

### 4.5 系统管理

| 页面 | 需求 |
|---|---|
| 用户与权限 | 管用户、角色、组织、数据范围、知识库权限 |
| 主数据映射 | 管油气区、油田、气田、井、别名、状态、唯一标识 |
| 模板与公式 | 管 Excel 模板、导出模板、字段公式、单元格规则 |
| 知识库管理 | 管文档上传、分类、版本、权限、失效 |
| 数据源与审计 | 管接口状态、同步日志、操作日志、AI 调用日志 |

## 五、关键业务规则

| 规则 | 说明 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|
| 三条线储量 | 国家线、内部线、上市线都要能分析和对比 | 口径 `[待确认]` |
| 3P3C | 储量模板包含 P1/P2/P3/C1/C2/C3 与商业性条件 | 细则 `[待确认]` |
| 产量状态 | 在生产、在建设、开发评价、勘探评价、待发现 | 来自技术规范 |
| 年度产量构成 | 基础产量、措施产量、调整井产量、开发井产量 | 来自 QHS 2062 |
| 字段公式 | 用字段名公式，不用 Excel 坐标公式 | 公式清单 `[待确认]` |
| 主数据 | 油田状态和井名唯一标识影响规划表计算 | 主键配置 `[待确认]` |
| 权限 | 会议记录暂定三级，Excel 框架提到一级/二级权限 | 最终矩阵 `[待确认]` |

## 六、非功能需求

| 类型 | 需求 |
|---|---|
| 安全 | 等保 2.0 二级，内网访问，统一认证，权限控制，审计日志 |
| 可用性 | 每个页面有加载、空态、错误态、权限态 |
| 可追溯 | 数据、规则、公式、版本、导出、AI 调用均可追溯 |
| 性能 | AI 查询响应、NL2SQL 准确率、版本差异检出等指标需确认 |
| 兼容 | Web/OA 系统形式兼容，桌面端优先 |
| 运维 | 监控巡检、知识库更新、备份、故障响应、日志分析 |

## 七、验收标准

| 模块 | 验收标准 |
|---|---|
| 储量分析 | 能用样例储量模板跑通采集、校验、指标分析、版本对比、成果输出 |
| 产量规划 | 能用样例规划模板跑通填报、公式提示、方案编制、剖面调整、版本对比、结果输出 |
| 智能辅助 | 能完成知识问答、问数、规律解释、工具调用，并展示引用/参数/日志 |
| 系统管理 | 能展示用户权限、主数据、模板公式、知识库、审计入口 |
| Demo | 所有 Mock 数据标识清楚，不能误导为真实敖钦/海能或真实生产数据 |

## 八、第一版 Demo 要求

第一版 Demo 用 Vue 工作台实现：

- 登录页支持多角色一键演示。
- 首页、储量采集、储量指标、储量版本、规划方案、剖面调整、规划版本、智能辅助做完整交互。
- 系统管理和错误页做基础页面。
- Mock 数据集中在 `src/mock/`。
- 所有复杂计算、AI 结果、权限差异均标注演示或 `[待确认]`。

## 九、待确认入口

全部待确认事项集中维护在 `08-待确认事项清单.md`。开发前必须逐项确认或明确暂缓。

馃毀 **GATE**: User has provided source material (PDF / DOCX / EPUB / URL / Markdown file / text description / conversation content 鈥?any form is acceptable).

> Converting via LibreOffice/Inkscape introduces CJK font substitution drift and
> rasterization loss; the original EMF/WMF is always higher fidelity than the converted PNG.

def validate(write_report=True) -> dict:
    ns = {"a": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/drawingml/2006/main"}
    fonts: dict[str, int] = {}
    sizes: list[float] = []
    body_sizes: list[float] = []
    ppt_texts: list[str] = []
    with zipfile.ZipFile(OUT_PPTX, "r") as zf:
        slide_names = [n for n in zf.namelist() if re.match(r"ppt/slides/slide\d+\.xml$", n)]
        media = [n for n in zf.namelist() if n.startswith("ppt/media/")]
        for name in slide_names:
            tree = ET.fromstring(zf.read(name))
            for r in tree.findall(".//a:r", ns):
                text = "".join((t.text or "") for t in r.findall("./a:t", ns)).strip()
                if not text:
                    continue
                ppt_texts.append(text)
                rpr = r.find("./a:rPr", ns)
                if rpr is None:
                    continue
                if rpr.attrib.get("sz"):
                    size = int(rpr.attrib["sz"]) / 100
                    sizes.append(size)
                    if len(text) >= 4 and not text.isdigit():
                        body_sizes.append(size)
                latin = rpr.find("./a:latin", ns)
                ea = rpr.find("./a:ea", ns)
                font = None
                if ea is not None and ea.attrib.get("typeface"):
                    font = ea.attrib["typeface"]
                elif latin is not None and latin.attrib.get("typeface"):
                    font = latin.attrib["typeface"]
                if font:
                    fonts[font] = fonts.get(font, 0) + 1
    text = OUT_OUTLINE.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if OUT_OUTLINE.exists() else ""
    text += OUT_CHECK.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if OUT_CHECK.exists() else ""
    text += "\n".join(ppt_texts)
    text += OUT_PPTX.name
    required = ["6+7+4", "17 椤?, "160 涓?, "54 涓补鐢?, "9 涓皵鐢?, "720 鍙ｄ簳", "20涓?"]
    bad_fonts = [f for f in fonts if f in {"瀹嬩綋", "浠垮畫", "Times New Roman"}]
    result = {
        "slides": len(slide_names),
        "media": len(media),
        "top_fonts": sorted(fonts.items(), key=lambda x: x[1], reverse=True)[:6],
        "min_size": min(sizes) if sizes else None,
        "min_body_size": min(body_sizes) if body_sizes else None,
        "missing": [item for item in required if item not in text],
        "bad_fonts": bad_fonts,
        "pptx": str(OUT_PPTX),
    }
    if write_report:
        OUT_CHECK.write_text(check_report(result), encoding="utf-8")
    return result

    images = sorted(

    thumbs = []
    for path in images:

        im.thumbnail((320, 180))
        canvas = Image.new("RGB", (340, 220), (236, 242, 250))
        canvas.paste(im, ((340 - im.width) // 2, 8))
        label = path.stem.encode("gbk", errors="ignore").decode("gbk", errors="ignore")
        # PIL's default font may not render Chinese reliably; file order is enough.
        thumbs.append(canvas)
    cols = 4
    rows = math.ceil(len(thumbs) / cols)

        sheet.paste(thumb, ((i % cols) * 340, (i // cols) * 220))
    out = PREVIEW_DIR / "contact_sheet.jpg"

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import math
import re
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path
from xml.etree import ElementTree as ET

from PIL import Image
from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.dml.color import RGBColor
from pptx.enum.text import MSO_ANCHOR, PP_ALIGN
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt

import ppt_v03_build as base


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
OUT_PPTX = ROOT / "敖钦项目启动汇报-第2-5部分-V0.5.pptx"
OUT_OUTLINE = ROOT / "敖钦项目启动汇报-第2-5部分-V0.5-大纲.md"
OUT_CHECK = ROOT / "敖钦项目启动汇报-第2-5部分-V0.5-自检报告.md"
PREVIEW_DIR = ROOT / "tools" / "ppt_v05_preview"

W, H = base.WIDE_W, base.WIDE_H
FONT = "微软雅黑"
base.FONT = FONT

NAVY = RGBColor(7, 54, 111)
BLUE = RGBColor(0, 102, 179)
BLUE2 = RGBColor(38, 132, 209)
TEAL = RGBColor(0, 150, 170)
GREEN = RGBColor(36, 145, 96)
ORANGE = RGBColor(240, 145, 40)
RED = RGBColor(194, 31, 48)
SKY = RGBColor(233, 244, 255)
SKY2 = RGBColor(218, 236, 252)
PALE = RGBColor(247, 250, 254)
WHITE = RGBColor(255, 255, 255)
TEXT = RGBColor(35, 45, 62)
MUTED = RGBColor(96, 108, 126)
BORDER = RGBColor(196, 213, 232)
LIGHT_RED = RGBColor(255, 239, 240)
LIGHT_ORANGE = RGBColor(255, 246, 232)
LIGHT_GREEN = RGBColor(237, 249, 242)

ASSET_DIR = base.ASSET_DIR
RESERVE_FLOW = ASSET_DIR / "【终】基于敖钦的储量及产量规划协同场景建设-0317" / "image15.png"
RESERVE_GEO = ASSET_DIR / "【终】基于敖钦的储量及产量规划协同场景建设-0317" / "image16.png"


def emu(value: float):
    return Inches(value)


def blank(prs: Presentation):
    return base.blank(prs)


def rect(slide, x, y, w, h, fill=WHITE, line=BORDER, radius=False, width=0.7):
    return base.add_rect(slide, emu(x), emu(y), emu(w), emu(h), fill, line, radius, width)


def line(slide, x1, y1, x2, y2, color=BLUE, width=1.5):
    return base.add_line(slide, emu(x1), emu(y1), emu(x2), emu(y2), color, width)


def txt(slide, x, y, w, h, text, size=12, color=TEXT, bold=False, align=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, valign=MSO_ANCHOR.TOP):
    box = base.add_text(slide, emu(x), emu(y), emu(w), emu(h), text, size, color, bold, align, valign)
    for p in box.text_frame.paragraphs:
        for run in p.runs:
            run.font.name = FONT
            run.font.size = Pt(size)
    return box


def title(slide, heading, sub="", page=None):
    base.header(slide, heading, sub, page)


def section(prs, num, heading, caption, bg):
    base.FONT = FONT
    return base.section_slide(prs, num, heading, caption, bg)


def add_bg(slide, color=WHITE):
    base.fill_bg(slide, color)


def img(slide, path, x, y, w, h, border=True):
    return base.add_image_contain(slide, Path(path), emu(x), emu(y), emu(w), emu(h), border)


def card(slide, x, y, w, h, head, body, color=BLUE, idx=None, body_size=10.5):
    rect(slide, x, y, w, h, WHITE, BORDER, True, 0.8)
    rect(slide, x, y, w, 0.36, color, color, True, 0)
    if idx:
        txt(slide, x + 0.13, y + 0.105, 0.34, 0.12, idx, 8.5, WHITE, True, PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
        tx = x + 0.54
    else:
        tx = x + 0.18
    txt(slide, tx, y + 0.095, w - (tx - x) - 0.14, 0.14, head, 10.5, WHITE, True)
    txt(slide, x + 0.18, y + 0.52, w - 0.34, h - 0.58, body, body_size, TEXT)


def kpi(slide, x, y, value, label, color=BLUE, w=1.95):
    rect(slide, x, y, w, 0.72, WHITE, BORDER, True, 0.7)
    rect(slide, x, y, 0.08, 0.72, color, color, False, 0)
    txt(slide, x + 0.18, y + 0.10, w - 0.26, 0.25, value, 18, color, True, PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    txt(slide, x + 0.14, y + 0.45, w - 0.22, 0.13, label, 9.2, MUTED, False, PP_ALIGN.CENTER)


def table(slide, x, y, w, h, headers, rows, widths=None, font=9.2, header_color=BLUE, highlight=True):
    widths = widths or [1] * len(headers)
    total = sum(widths)
    widths = [w * each / total for each in widths]
    row_h = h / (len(rows) + 1)
    cx = x
    for i, head in enumerate(headers):
        rect(slide, cx, y, widths[i], row_h, header_color, header_color, False, 0)
        txt(slide, cx + 0.05, y + row_h * 0.30, widths[i] - 0.10, row_h * 0.25, str(head), font + 0.8, WHITE, True, PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
        cx += widths[i]
    for r, row in enumerate(rows):
        cy = y + row_h * (r + 1)
        cx = x
        fill = RGBColor(248, 251, 255) if r % 2 == 0 else WHITE
        for c, cell in enumerate(row):
            text = str(cell)
            color = TEXT
            cfill = fill
            if highlight and ("待确认" in text or "风险" in text or "冲突" in text):
                color = RED
                cfill = LIGHT_RED
            rect(slide, cx, cy, widths[c], row_h, cfill, BORDER, False, 0.45)
            txt(slide, cx + 0.07, cy + row_h * 0.22, widths[c] - 0.13, row_h * 0.44, text, font, color, False)
            cx += widths[c]


def flow(slide, items, x, y, w, h, colors=None, size=9.2):
    colors = colors or [BLUE, TEAL, GREEN, ORANGE, RED, BLUE2]
    gap = 0.18
    bw = (w - gap * (len(items) - 1)) / len(items)
    for i, (head, body) in enumerate(items):
        bx = x + i * (bw + gap)
        rect(slide, bx, y, bw, h, WHITE, colors[i % len(colors)], True, 1.2)
        rect(slide, bx, y, bw, 0.34, colors[i % len(colors)], colors[i % len(colors)], True, 0)
        txt(slide, bx, y + 0.10, bw, 0.12, f"{i+1}  {head}", 9.5, WHITE, True, PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
        txt(slide, bx + 0.10, y + 0.49, bw - 0.20, h - 0.56, body, size, TEXT, False, PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
        if i < len(items) - 1:
            line(slide, bx + bw, y + h / 2, bx + bw + gap, y + h / 2, colors[i % len(colors)], 1.8)


def note(slide, text):
    rect(slide, 0.62, 6.18, 12.10, 0.46, SKY, BORDER, True, 0.6)
    txt(slide, 0.88, 6.31, 11.58, 0.13, text, 9.5, NAVY, True, PP_ALIGN.CENTER)


def s02(prs):
    slide = blank(prs); add_bg(slide, WHITE)
    title(slide, "背景总览：从集团数智化牵引到储量产量协同落地", "本页回答项目为什么要做、为什么现在做、要落到哪类业务成果", 2)
    img(slide, base.PLATFORM, 9.35, 1.10, 2.90, 1.65, False)
    items = [
        ("政策与集团牵引", "人工智能+、数字化转型、核心业务线上协同，要求关键经营流程可沉淀、可追溯、可复用。", BLUE),
        ("深圳分公司诉求", "围绕增储上产、稳产上产和资源经营决策，把储量与产量规划从线下经验流转拉到统一平台。", TEAL),
        ("业务基础成熟", "已有海能平台、敖钦智能体、储量/产量模板、历史数据、会议记录和技术规范，可进入场景建设。", GREEN),
        ("实施窗口需确认", "总预算 160 万；材料存在 8 个月和 12 个月两种周期口径，正式排期需统一确认。", ORANGE),
    ]
    for i, (h, b, c) in enumerate(items):
        card(slide, 0.62 + (i % 2) * 4.28, 1.18 + (i // 2) * 1.52, 3.95, 1.12, h, b, c, f"{i+1}", 10)
    table(slide, 0.62, 4.62, 11.68, 0.98, ["前期指挥方向", "落到项目里的动作", "形成的交付/能力"],
          [["不替换平台", "复用海能、敖钦和既有源系统", "统一入口、调用边界、审计留痕"],
           ["先统一口径", "模板、字段、公式、主数据、版本先治理", "储量/产量同口径分析与输出"]],
          [1.05, 1.55, 1.55], 9.4)
    note(slide, "汇报结论：这不是单点工具建设，而是把储量、产量规划、智能辅助和系统底座组织成可落地的业务协同工程。")


def s03(prs):
    slide = blank(prs); add_bg(slide, PALE)
    title(slide, "场景价值：储量与产量规划要形成同一条经营协同闭环", "储量解决资源家底与口径沉淀，产量规划解决方案编制与滚动调整，两者共同服务经营决策", 3)
    img(slide, base.RESERVE_MAP, 0.62, 1.16, 2.45, 1.32)
    img(slide, base.PROD_EXCEL, 10.22, 1.16, 2.55, 1.32)
    rect(slide, 5.35, 1.78, 2.70, 0.98, NAVY, NAVY, True, 0)
    txt(slide, 5.65, 2.02, 2.10, 0.22, "协同闭环", 19, WHITE, True, PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    txt(slide, 5.58, 2.42, 2.24, 0.11, "数据、口径、版本、结果统一留痕", 9.0, RGBColor(220, 235, 250), False, PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    flow(slide, [("采集", "内部储量/动储量/历史数据"), ("校验", "字段、单位、范围、模板"), ("分析", "三条线、3P3C、难动用"), ("输出", "版本对比、成果图表")], 0.62, 3.26, 5.36, 0.92, [BLUE, BLUE, BLUE, BLUE], 9.0)
    flow(slide, [("填报", "油区/油田/井多层级协同"), ("编制", "年度/五年/滚动/专项方案"), ("调整", "剖面调整、智能排期"), ("输出", "版本对比、规划成果")], 7.40, 3.26, 5.36, 0.92, [TEAL, TEAL, TEAL, TEAL], 9.0)
    table(slide, 0.62, 4.72, 12.10, 0.90, ["链路", "当前分散状态", "协同后变化", "领导能看到什么"],
          [["资源家底", "数据、图件、口径分散", "统一采集校验、版本沉淀", "家底可信、口径清楚"],
           ["方案编制", "Excel 多轮分发与汇总", "类 Excel 协同、公式统一", "进度清楚、差异可追"]],
          [0.72, 1.40, 1.42, 1.18], 9.0)
    note(slide, "价值核心：从资源家底、方案编制到经营汇报，都能回溯来源、口径、参数、版本和责任。")


def s04(prs):
    slide = blank(prs); add_bg(slide, WHITE)
    title(slide, "建设必要性：当前问题不是效率单点，而是流程没有系统化", "数据、计算、查询三类问题互相叠加，导致储量和产量规划仍依赖 Excel 与人工经验", 4)
    for i, (v, l, c) in enumerate([("130+", "储量统计参与员工", BLUE), ("近6个月", "人工统计周期", RED), ("5轮+", "2026产量计划调整", ORANGE), ("83.3%", "储量统计提效目标", GREEN), ("85.7%", "规划效率提升目标", TEAL)]):

# PPT Master Skill

> AI-driven multi-format SVG content generation system. Converts source documents into high-quality SVG pages through multi-role collaboration and exports to PPTX.

**Core Pipeline**: `Source Document 鈫?Create Project 鈫?[Template] 鈫?Strategist 鈫?[Image_Generator] 鈫?Executor Live Preview 鈫?Quality Check 鈫?Post-processing 鈫?Export`

> [!CAUTION]
> ## 馃毃 Global Execution Discipline (MANDATORY)
>
> **This workflow is a strict serial pipeline. The following rules have the highest priority 鈥?violating any one of them constitutes execution failure:**
>
> 1. **SERIAL EXECUTION** 鈥?Steps MUST be executed in order; the output of each step is the input for the next. Non-BLOCKING adjacent steps may proceed continuously once prerequisites are met, without waiting for the user to say "continue"
> 2. **BLOCKING = HARD STOP** 鈥?Steps marked 鉀?BLOCKING require a full stop; the AI MUST wait for an explicit user response before proceeding and MUST NOT make any decisions on behalf of the user
> 3. **NO CROSS-PHASE BUNDLING** 鈥?Cross-phase bundling is FORBIDDEN. (Note: the Eight Confirmations in Step 4 are 鉀?BLOCKING 鈥?the AI MUST present recommendations and wait for explicit user confirmation before proceeding. Once the user confirms, all subsequent non-BLOCKING steps 鈥?design spec output, SVG generation, speaker notes, and post-processing 鈥?may proceed automatically without further user confirmation)
> 4. **GATE BEFORE ENTRY** 鈥?Each Step has prerequisites (馃毀 GATE) listed at the top; these MUST be verified before starting that Step
> 5. **NO SPECULATIVE EXECUTION** 鈥?"Pre-preparing" content for subsequent Steps is FORBIDDEN (e.g., writing SVG code during the Strategist phase)
> 6. **NO SUB-AGENT SVG GENERATION** 鈥?Executor Step 6 SVG generation is context-dependent and MUST be completed by the current main agent end-to-end. Delegating page SVG generation to sub-agents is FORBIDDEN
> 7. **SEQUENTIAL PAGE GENERATION ONLY** 鈥?In Executor Step 6, after the global design context is confirmed, SVG pages MUST be generated sequentially page by page in one continuous pass. Grouped page batches (for example, 5 pages at a time) are FORBIDDEN
> 8. **SPEC_LOCK RE-READ PER PAGE** 鈥?Before generating each SVG page, Executor MUST `read_file <project_path>/spec_lock.md`. All colors / fonts / icons / images MUST come from this file 鈥?no values from memory or invented on the fly. Executor MUST also look up the current page's `page_rhythm` (`anchor` / `dense` / `breathing`), `page_layouts` (which template SVG to inherit, if any), and `page_charts` (which chart template to adapt, if any). Empty / absent entries are intentional Strategist signals 鈥?see executor-base.md 搂2.1. This rule exists to resist context-compression drift on long decks and to break the uniform "every page is a card grid" default
> 9. **SVG MUST BE HAND-WRITTEN, NOT SCRIPT-GENERATED** 鈥?Every SVG page is written by the main agent directly, one page at a time (see rules 6 and 7). Writing or running a Python / Node / shell script that produces the SVG files in batch 鈥?looping over pages, templating from data, or emitting them via a generator 鈥?is FORBIDDEN, including under "save tokens", "quick draft", or "user is in a hurry" pretexts. The script-generation path was tried on a feature branch and abandoned: cross-page visual consistency depends on per-page authoring with full upstream context, which a generator script cannot reproduce
> 10. **FOLLOW DETERMINISTIC ROUTING RULES** 鈥?Do not add blocking routing questions when this skill defines a route. If the user request violates a route precondition, state the required prerequisite and stop that route instead of asking the user to choose around the rule. Ordinary finite options, stylistic preferences, and recoverable details are surfaced with a recommended value plus alternatives at the next existing confirmation gate.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> ## 馃寪 Language & Communication Rule
>
> - **Response language**: match the user's input and source materials. Explicit user override (e.g., "璇风敤鑻辨枃鍥炵瓟") takes precedence.

English enum IDs / file fields may appear in parentheses for precision, but never rely on English-only labels such as `deck`, `layout`, `mirror`, or `fidelity` without a localized explanation.
> - **Template format**: `design_spec.md` MUST follow its original English template structure (section headings, field names) regardless of conversation language. Content values may be in the user's language.

> ## 馃攲 Compatibility With Generic Coding Skills

# PPT Master Skill

> AI-driven multi-format SVG content generation system. Converts source documents into high-quality SVG pages through multi-role collaboration and exports to PPTX.

**Core Pipeline**: `Source Document → Create Project → [Template] → Strategist → [Image_Generator] → Executor Live Preview → Quality Check → Post-processing → Export`

> [!CAUTION]
> ## 🚨 Global Execution Discipline (MANDATORY)
>
> **This workflow is a strict serial pipeline. The following rules have the highest priority — violating any one of them constitutes execution failure:**
>
> 1. **SERIAL EXECUTION** — Steps MUST be executed in order; the output of each step is the input for the next. Non-BLOCKING adjacent steps may proceed continuously once prerequisites are met, without waiting for the user to say "continue"
> 2. **BLOCKING = HARD STOP** — Steps marked ⛔ BLOCKING require a full stop; the AI MUST wait for an explicit user response before proceeding and MUST NOT make any decisions on behalf of the user
> 3. **NO CROSS-PHASE BUNDLING** — Cross-phase bundling is FORBIDDEN. (Note: the Eight Confirmations in Step 4 are ⛔ BLOCKING — the AI MUST present recommendations and wait for explicit user confirmation before proceeding. Once the user confirms, all subsequent non-BLOCKING steps — design spec output, SVG generation, speaker notes, and post-processing — may proceed automatically without further user confirmation)
> 4. **GATE BEFORE ENTRY** — Each Step has prerequisites (🚧 GATE) listed at the top; these MUST be verified before starting that Step
> 5. **NO SPECULATIVE EXECUTION** — "Pre-preparing" content for subsequent Steps is FORBIDDEN (e.g., writing SVG code during the Strategist phase)
> 6. **NO SUB-AGENT SVG GENERATION** — Executor Step 6 SVG generation is context-dependent and MUST be completed by the current main agent end-to-end. Delegating page SVG generation to sub-agents is FORBIDDEN
> 7. **SEQUENTIAL PAGE GENERATION ONLY** — In Executor Step 6, after the global design context is confirmed, SVG pages MUST be generated sequentially page by page in one continuous pass. Grouped page batches (for example, 5 pages at a time) are FORBIDDEN
> 8. **SPEC_LOCK RE-READ PER PAGE** — Before generating each SVG page, Executor MUST `read_file <project_path>/spec_lock.md`. All colors / fonts / icons / images MUST come from this file — no values from memory or invented on the fly. Executor MUST also look up the current page's `page_rhythm` (`anchor` / `dense` / `breathing`), `page_layouts` (which template SVG to inherit, if any), and `page_charts` (which chart template to adapt, if any). Empty / absent entries are intentional Strategist signals — see executor-base.md §2.1. This rule exists to resist context-compression drift on long decks and to break the uniform "every page is a card grid" default
> 9. **SVG MUST BE HAND-WRITTEN, NOT SCRIPT-GENERATED** — Every SVG page is written by the main agent directly, one page at a time (see rules 6 and 7). Writing or running a Python / Node / shell script that produces the SVG files in batch — looping over pages, templating from data, or emitting them via a generator — is FORBIDDEN, including under "save tokens", "quick draft", or "user is in a hurry" pretexts. The script-generation path was tried on a feature branch and abandoned: cross-page visual consistency depends on per-page authoring with full upstream context, which a generator script cannot reproduce
> 10. **FOLLOW DETERMINISTIC ROUTING RULES** — Do not add blocking routing questions when this skill defines a route. If the user request violates a route precondition, state the required prerequisite and stop that route instead of asking the user to choose around the rule. Ordinary finite options, stylistic preferences, and recoverable details are surfaced with a recommended value plus alternatives at the next existing confirmation gate.

> ## 🌐 Language & Communication Rule
>
> - **Response language**: match the user's input and source materials. Explicit user override (e.g., "请用英文回答") takes precedence.
> - **User-facing option labels**: when presenting confirmations, brief proposals, choices, or finite option sets, use the user's language for labels and explanations. English enum IDs / file fields may appear in parentheses for precision, but never rely on English-only labels such as `deck`, `layout`, `mirror`, or `fidelity` without a localized explanation.
> - **Template format**: `design_spec.md` MUST follow its original English template structure (section headings, field names) regardless of conversation language. Content values may be in the user's language.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> ## 🔌 Compatibility With Generic Coding Skills

> - `ppt-master` is a repository-specific workflow, not a general application scaffold
> - Do NOT create `.worktrees/`, `tests/`, branch workflows, or generic engineering structure by default

## Rule Strength Labels

## Workflow

### Step 1: Source Content Processing

🚧 **GATE**: User has provided source material (PDF / DOCX / EPUB / URL / Markdown file / text description / conversation content — any form is acceptable).

> **No source content?** When the user supplies only a topic name or requirements without any file or substantive description, run the [`topic-research`](workflows/topic-research.md) workflow first, then return here with its products as input.

When the user provides non-Markdown content, convert immediately through the
unified dispatcher. It preserves the backend converters' existing behavior,
routes by source type, and writes the standard Markdown plus conversion profile.

| User Provides | Action |
|---------------|--------|
| PDF / DOCX / Office document / XLSX / XLSM / PPTX / EPUB / HTML / LaTeX / RST / web URL | `python3 ${SKILL_DIR}/scripts/source_to_md.py <file_or_URL_or_dir> [<file_or_URL_or_dir> ...]` |
| CSV / TSV | Read directly as plain-text table source |
| Markdown | Read directly |

For PPTX sources, Step 1 converts the deck to Markdown content; after Step 2
`import-sources`, standard PPTX intake is also written to `<project>/analysis/`.
Use `source_to_md.py -t <type>` only when extension detection is ambiguous.
Default local conversion writes Markdown/profile outputs beside each source file.
Use `-o` only when a specific output file/directory is required; with multiple
inputs or directory inputs, `-o` is an output directory. Backend converter details are documented in
[`scripts/docs/conversion.md`](scripts/docs/conversion.md).

> **Office vector assets (EMF/WMF) from DOCX/PPTX sources**:
> Source conversion extracts embedded Office vector images (.emf/.wmf)
> alongside bitmap images when the source format exposes them. After `import-sources`, these land in `images/`
> together with `image_manifest.json` and are first-class assets in §VIII Image Resource List.
>
> **Do NOT convert EMF/WMF to PNG.** The PPT Master pipeline preserves them as external
> references (`finalize_svg.py` skips them) and `svg_to_pptx.py` embeds them as
> PPTX-native media via `image/x-emf` / `image/x-wmf` MIME — PowerPoint renders them at full vector fidelity.
> Converting via LibreOffice/Inkscape introduces CJK font substitution drift and
> rasterization loss; the original EMF/WMF is always higher fidelity than the converted PNG.
>
> Browser-based live preview cannot render EMF (will show blank) — this is expected;
> the PPTX output is the source of truth.

**✅ Checkpoint — Confirm source content is ready, proceed to Step 2.**

---

### Step 2: Project Initialization

🚧 **GATE**: Step 1 complete; source content is ready (Markdown file, user-provided text, or requirements described in conversation are all valid).

```bash
python3 ${SKILL_DIR}/scripts/project_manager.py init <project_name> --format <format>
```

Format options must be named with concrete dimensions. Default: `ppt169` = `1280x720`, `viewBox="0 0 1280 720"`. Other examples: `ppt43` = `1024x768`, `story` = `1080x1920`, `banner` = `1920x1080`. For the full format list, see `references/canvas-formats.md`.

Import source content (choose based on the situation):

| Situation | Action |
|-----------|--------|
| Has source files (PDF/MD/etc.) | `python3 ${SKILL_DIR}/scripts/project_manager.py import-sources <project_path> <source_files_or_dirs...> --move` |
| User provided text directly in conversation | No import needed — content is already in conversation context; subsequent steps can reference it directly |

For PPTX sources, `import-sources` automatically runs the standard intake enrichment:

```bash
python3 ${SKILL_DIR}/scripts/pptx_intake.py <project_path>/sources/<source.pptx> -o <project_path>/analysis
```

For each PPTX it writes `<stem>.identity.json` (canvas, theme palette/fonts, observed usage) and `<stem>.slide_library.json` (text slots, geometry, native tables, native chart caches), and merges that deck's Strategist-facing digest into the single multi-deck index `analysis/source_profile.json` (`decks[]`, one self-contained entry per source deck, with prefixed artifact pointers). In the main generation path these are source facts and recommendation candidates, not replica constraints; beautify and template-fill workflows decide separately which fields become locked constraints.

Multi-deck: several PPTX files may be imported into one main-pipeline project — each gets its own `<stem>.*` artifacts and a deck entry in `source_profile.json`. `source_profile.json` stays the single must-read index (one entry for a one-deck project, several for a combined-source project). Stems must be distinct; re-importing the same stem replaces that deck's entry. The beautify / template-fill workflows remain single-deck (1:1 to one chosen source deck) and read that deck's `<stem>.*` artifacts.

> ⚠️ **MUST use `--move`** (not copy): all source files — Step 1's generated Markdown, original PDFs / MDs / images — go into `sources/` via `import-sources --move`. If Step 1 wrote Markdown beside the original sources, pass that source path/directory once. If Step 1 used `-o` to write Markdown elsewhere, pass both the original source path(s)/directory and the Markdown output path(s)/directory. After execution they no longer exist at the original location. Intermediate artifacts (e.g., `_files/`) are handled automatically.

**✅ Checkpoint — Confirm project structure created successfully, `sources/` contains all source files, converted materials are ready. Proceed to Step 3.**

### Step 3: Template Option

🚧 **GATE**: Step 2 complete; project directory structure is ready.

**Default — free design.** Proceed directly to Step 4. Do NOT query any `*_index.json` unless triggered. Do NOT ask the user. Do NOT proactively suggest, hint at, or fuzzy-match any template based on content, slug-like words, or vague style descriptions.

**Hard boundary — raw PPTX template references are not Step 3 templates.** PPTX-as-source remains valid in Step 1 / Step 2, and raw PPTX template + generated PPTX routes to `template-fill`. But if the user wants the SVG/template-based generation route from that PPTX, stop before Step 3. The user must first run [`workflows/create-template.md`](workflows/create-template.md), then return with the generated template directory path. Step 3 only consumes an explicit template directory that already contains `design_spec.md` with `kind: brand` / `kind: layout` / `kind: deck`.

Do **not** reinterpret this boundary as 1:1 redesign or free SVG generation. Use `template-fill` for raw PPTX template + generated PPTX requests; use `beautify` only when the source deck's page count, order, and wording are preserved.

**Template flow triggers ONLY on explicit directory paths** supplied by the user in their initial message. The trigger rule is mechanical, not interpretive:

| User input contains | Step 3 action |
|---|---|
| One or more explicit template directory paths (each resolves to a directory containing `design_spec.md` with `kind: brand` / `kind: layout` / `kind: deck` in its YAML frontmatter) | Read each spec's `kind`, dispatch per the kind matrix below, fuse if multiple |
| Anything else — bare template names ("用 academic_defense"), style descriptions ("麦肯锡风格"), brand mentions ("招商银行风格"), vague intent ("想用个模板"), or silence | Skip Step 3, free design |

There is no slug matching, no name lookup, no fuzzy resolution. A name without a path does not trigger — the user must give a path the AI can `cd` into.

> Style descriptions ("麦肯锡风格" / "Keynote 风" / "极简风" / etc.) never trigger Step 3. They flow into Strategist's Eight Confirmations as a style brief (color / typography / tone in confirmations e–g).

> Bare names ("academic_defense", "招商银行", "anthropic") do NOT trigger Step 3 even if a matching directory exists in the library. The user must give a path. AI must not "helpfully" resolve a name to a path.

> "What templates exist?" is out-of-band Q&A — answer by listing entries from `brands_index.json` / `layouts_index.json` / `decks_index.json` together with their paths. Listing alone does not advance the pipeline; the user must send a path back to trigger Step 3.

> To create a new layout or deck, read [`workflows/create-template.md`](workflows/create-template.md). To create a new brand, read [`workflows/create-brand.md`](workflows/create-brand.md).

#### Three template kinds

The architecture has three independent reference bundles. Full schema in [`docs/zh/templates-architecture.md`](../../docs/zh/templates-architecture.md). Summary:

| Kind | Physical dir | Contains | Frontmatter |
|---|---|---|---|
| **brand** | `templates/brands/<id>/` | identity-only segment: color / typography / logo / voice / icon style | `kind: brand` |
| **layout** | `templates/layouts/<id>/` | structure-only segment: canvas / page structure / p…8572 tokens truncated… Path B even when `IMAGE_BACKEND` is configured; `api` forces Path A; `manual` forces offline. Never run `image_gen.py --manifest` when the confirmed value is `host-native` or `manual`. Full selection rule: [image-generator.md](references/image-generator.md) §7 Path Selection.

Workflow:

1. Extract all resource rows from the design spec and group them by `Acquire Via`; rows with `Status: Pending` or `Status: Failed` and `Acquire Via ∈ {ai, web, slice}` must all reach a terminal state before Executor starts
2. Generate prompts (ai rows) and/or run search (web rows) per [image-base.md](references/image-base.md) §3 dispatch table
2.5. **Slice any spot-illustration sheets (only if `slice` rows exist).** For each generated `ai` **sheet** row, run `slice_images.py` (grid + the element `--names` matching the `slice` rows, `--trim --alpha`) so every element file lands in `images/`; mark each `slice` row `Generated`. A sheet still in `Needs-Manual` cannot be sliced — leave its `slice` rows `Needs-Manual` and surface them at the Step 7 readiness gate. Contract: [image-generator.md](references/image-generator.md) §4.3.
3. Verify every row reaches a terminal status: `Generated` (ai success / sliced element), `Sourced` (web success), or `Needs-Manual`. `Failed` is not a terminal status: it means the current run did not generate that item, but the item remains retryable. The agent must resolve every residual `Failed` item by rerunning the confirmed path or marking it `Needs-Manual` before Executor starts
4. Re-derive image facts now that web / AI / sliced files are in the folder — `python3 ${SKILL_DIR}/scripts/analyze_images.py <project_path>/images` — so `analysis/image_analysis.csv` reflects every acquired image **including the sliced elements** (real measured sizes) before the Executor lays them out. Image facts are regenerated on use, never a stale store (see Step 4's image-facts note).

**✅ Checkpoint — Confirm acquisition attempted for every row**:
```markdown
## ✅ Image Acquisition Phase Complete
- [x] image_prompts.json created (when any ai rows processed)
- [x] image_prompts.md sidecar rendered (when any ai rows processed)
- [x] image_sources.json created (when any web rows processed)
- [x] Spot-illustration sheets sliced (when any `slice` rows exist); every element file present in `images/` and listed in `spec_lock.md images`
- [x] Each row: status is `Generated` / `Sourced` / `Needs-Manual` (no `Pending` or `Failed` remaining)
- [x] analyze_images.py re-run so image_analysis.csv covers the acquired web / AI / sliced images
```

**Default — auto-proceed to Step 6.** Only when the user's Step 4 response explicitly opted into split mode (in chat or via Confirm UI `result.json` with `generation_mode: "split"`), output the Phase A hand-off below and stop this conversation:

  ```markdown
  ## ✅ Phase A Complete
  - [x] Spec: `design_spec.md`, `spec_lock.md`
  - [x] Resources: `sources/`, `images/`, `templates/`
  - [ ] **Next**: open a fresh chat window and input `继续生成 projects/<project_name>` to enter Phase B via the [`resume-execute`](workflows/resume-execute.md) workflow.
  ```

> On acquisition failure, do NOT halt — follow the Failure Handling rule in [image-base.md](references/image-base.md) §5: retry once, then mark the row `Needs-Manual`, report to user, and continue to the checkpoint above.

### Step 6: Executor Phase

🚧 **GATE**: Step 4 (and Step 5 if triggered) complete; all prerequisite deliverables are ready.

**Artifact ownership**: `svg_output/` is the author source, `svg_final/` is derived, and image facts come from the regenerated `analysis/image_analysis.csv`; see [`references/artifact-ownership.md`](references/artifact-ownership.md).

Read the execution references for this deck's locked `mode` + `visual_style` (from `spec_lock.md`):
```
Read references/executor-base.md                  # REQUIRED: common guidelines
Read references/shared-standards.md               # REQUIRED: SVG/PPT technical constraints
Read references/modes/<locked-mode>.md            # narrative skeleton (spec_lock.md `mode`)
Read references/visual-styles/<locked-style>.md   # aesthetic (spec_lock.md `visual_style`)
```

> Read executor-base + shared-standards + the one locked mode file + the one locked visual-style file. For `mode: custom` or `visual_style: custom`, skip that preset file and follow `mode_behavior` / `visual_style_behavior` from `spec_lock.md` instead. Never glob `modes/` or `visual-styles/`.

**Design Parameter Confirmation (Mandatory)**: before the first SVG, output key design parameters from the spec (canvas dimensions, color scheme, font plan, body font size). See executor-base.md §2.

**Live Preview Auto-Startup (Mandatory)**: before the first SVG, automatically start the browser editor in live mode and keep it running continuously through Executor + Step 7 export:
```bash
python3 ${SKILL_DIR}/scripts/svg_editor/server.py <project_path> --live --daemon
```
- Start it immediately when Executor begins; `svg_output/` may be empty. Editor opens at `http://localhost:5050`; if another project already holds it, the launcher **auto-advances to the next free port** — read the actual URL from the launch log and report that.
- Run it as a long-running side process/session; do not wait for it to exit before generating SVG pages. Do not wait for user confirmation after startup.
- **Service must keep running** until one of: (a) the user clicks **Exit preview** in the browser, or (b) the user explicitly asks in chat to stop it. Generation continues even if the user closes the editor.
- **Do NOT read or apply submitted annotations during generation.** Users may annotate at any time, but Executor proceeds without touching them. The window to apply annotations opens only after Step 7 completes — see [`workflows/live-preview.md`](workflows/live-preview.md).
- The editor also supports **staged direct edits** (text content + SVG element attributes previewed immediately, then written to `svg_output/` only when the user clicks **Apply changes**; `Ctrl+Z` / Undo drops staged edits) alongside annotation; re-export stays chat-driven. Full scope and editor details: see [`workflows/live-preview.md`](workflows/live-preview.md) Notes.

**Pre-generation Batch Read (Mandatory)**: before the first SVG, batch-read every distinct layout SVG referenced in `spec_lock.page_layouts` and every distinct chart SVG referenced in `spec_lock.page_charts` (plus any §VII backup charts). One read per file, up front — do not re-read these during page generation. See executor-base.md §1.0.

> Image facts: trust the `analysis/image_analysis.csv` regenerated at the end of Step 5. If `images/` changed since (the user swapped or added files), re-run `python3 ${SKILL_DIR}/scripts/analyze_images.py <project_path>/images` before laying images out — facts are re-derived on use, never a stale store (Step 4 image-facts note).

**Per-page spec_lock re-read (Mandatory)**: before **each** SVG page, `read_file <project_path>/spec_lock.md` and use only its colors / fonts / icons / images, plus the per-page `page_rhythm` / `page_layouts` / `page_charts` lookups (resolves to template SVGs already loaded in the batch read above). Resists context-compression drift on long decks. See executor-base.md §2.1.

> ⚠️ **Main-agent only**: SVG generation MUST stay in the current main agent — page design depends on full upstream context. Do NOT delegate to sub-agents.
> ⚠️ **Generation rhythm**: generate pages sequentially, one at a time, in the same continuous context. Do NOT batch (e.g., 5 per group).

**Visual Construction Phase**: generate SVG pages sequentially, one at a time, in one continuous pass → `<project_path>/svg_output/`

**Quality Check Gate (Mandatory)** — after all SVGs, BEFORE annotation handling and speaker notes:
```bash
python3 ${SKILL_DIR}/scripts/svg_quality_checker.py <project_path>
```
- Any `error` (banned SVG features, viewBox mismatch, spec_lock drift, etc.) MUST be fixed before proceeding — return to Visual Construction, regenerate that page, re-run check.
- `warning` entries (low-res image, non-PPT-safe font tail, etc.): fix when straightforward, otherwise acknowledge and release.
- Run against `svg_output/` (not after `finalize_svg.py` — finalize rewrites SVG and masks violations).

**Logic Construction Phase**: generate speaker notes → `<project_path>/notes/total.md`

**✅ Checkpoint — Confirm all SVGs and notes are fully generated and quality-checked. Proceed directly to Step 7 post-processing**:
```markdown
## ✅ Executor Phase Complete
- [x] Live preview started and kept available at the reported URL
- [x] All SVGs generated to svg_output/
- [x] svg_quality_checker.py passed (0 errors)
- [x] Speaker notes generated at notes/total.md
```

> **Chart pages?** If this deck contains data charts (bar / line / pie / radar / etc.), run the standalone [`verify-charts`](workflows/verify-charts.md) workflow before Step 7 to calibrate coordinates. AI models routinely introduce 10–50 px errors when mapping data to pixel positions; verify-charts eliminates that class of error. Skip if no chart pages.

> **Visual self-check (opt-in)?** If the user explicitly asked for a per-page visual re-pass on the SVGs ("跑一下视觉自检 / 视觉回看", "visual review", "check pages visually", etc.), run the standalone [`visual-review`](workflows/visual-review.md) workflow before Step 7. Do NOT run it by default and do NOT recommend it based on inferred model capability or deck size — trigger is user request only.

### Step 7: Post-processing & Export

🚧 **GATE**: Step 6 complete; all SVGs generated to `svg_output/`; speaker notes `notes/total.md` generated.

🚧 **Image readiness GATE** (when Step 5 left ai rows in `Needs-Manual`): every expected file must exist at `project/images/<filename>` before running 7.1.

**Failure recovery**: if a Step 7 command fails, fix the owning source artifact and resume from the failed sub-step per [`workflows/failure-recovery.md`](workflows/failure-recovery.md). Do not restart Phase A unless the owning source changed.

> If files are missing: PAUSE, list the missing filenames, point the user to `images/image_prompts.md` (each `### Image N:` block is paste-ready for ChatGPT / Gemini / Midjourney; auto-generated from `image_prompts.json`) and the required placement `project/images/<filename>`. Resume Step 7.1 only after all expected files are in place. `finalize_svg.py` and `svg_to_pptx.py` do not detect missing files at this layer — proceeding with gaps produces a deck with broken image references.

> **Spot-illustration sheets at this gate**: `slice` element files are **derived**, not placed by the user. If a sheet was `Needs-Manual` (offline), the element files do not exist yet — list the **sheet** filename (`images/<sheet>.png`) plus its element target names, and instruct: place the sheet, then run the Step 5 `slice_images.py` command for it, then re-run `analyze_images.py`, before resuming 7.1. Never tell the user to hand-place the individual element files — they only come from slicing the sheet.

> ⚠️ Run the three sub-steps **one at a time** — each must complete successfully before the next.
> ❌ **NEVER** combine them into a single code block or shell invocation.

Canonical three-command pipeline (mirrors `references/shared-standards.md` §5):

**Step 7.1** — Split speaker notes:
```bash
python3 ${SKILL_DIR}/scripts/total_md_split.py <project_path>
```

**Step 7.2** — SVG post-processing (icon embedding / image crop & embed / raster image optimization / text flattening / rounded rect to path):
```bash
python3 ${SKILL_DIR}/scripts/finalize_svg.py <project_path>
```
Default raster handling for `svg_final/`: images are embedded at the rendered SVG size budget (`--image-scale 2`, `--max-dimension 2560`), opaque PNG photos may be written as JPEG, and transparent assets remain PNG. Use `--no-compress` or a higher `--max-dimension` only for diagnostic / high-fidelity SVG snapshots.

**Step 7.3** — Export PPTX (embeds speaker notes by default):
```bash
python3 ${SKILL_DIR}/scripts/svg_to_pptx.py <project_path>
# Output (default-flow mode):
#   exports/<project_name>_<timestamp>.pptx           ← native pptx (canonical output, reads svg_output/)
#   backup/<timestamp>/svg_output/                    ← Executor SVG source backup (always written)
#
# Add --svg-snapshot to additionally emit the SVG-image preview pptx alongside the native pptx:
#   exports/<project_name>_<timestamp>_svg.pptx      ← SVG preview pptx (reads svg_final/)
```

> The native pptx consumes `svg_output/` directly so the converter can preserve
> high-fidelity primitives (icon `<use>` placeholders, image `preserveAspectRatio`
> → native picture crop metadata, rounded rect `rx/ry` → `prstGeom roundRect`).
> Native raster images are optimized by default before writing `ppt/media`
> (`--image-sizing cap`, `--image-max-dimension 2560`, `--image-quality 85`).
> This optimization downscales only oversized full source images; it does not
> crop pixels out of embedded PPTX media, and it does not reduce a small
> placement image merely because it is currently displayed small. Display
> cropping remains editable PPT picture-crop metadata. Add `--no-image-optimize`
> only when the deck must retain original image bytes. Use
> `--image-sizing display --image-scale 2` only for aggressive size reduction.
> The `svg_output/`
> snapshot in `backup/<timestamp>/` is always written so the project can be
> re-exported from frozen SVG sources without re-running the LLM. The SVG-rendered
> preview pptx is opt-in via `--svg-snapshot` — live preview already provides the
> SVG visual reference, so it's only needed when you want a self-contained file
> to share. Pass `-s output` or `-s final` to force a single source if you need it.

> **Paragraph editability vs line fidelity** — by default, mergeable dy-stacked
> paragraph blocks collapse into one editable PowerPoint text frame with multiple
> `<a:p>`, improving body-text editing and resize/reflow behavior. Add `--no-merge`
> only when the user explicitly asks for strict line-layout fidelity or when a
> layout-tight page must keep every dy-stacked line as its own text frame. The
